subject: ddply -apply numcolwise while keeping non-numerical columns

messages.author: e53f91d0708becab
messages.subject: ddply -apply numcolwise while keeping non-numerical columns
parts:
I'm trying to apply numcolwise(sum) (our colwise(sum)) to a dataframe
that contains factor and character columns that I want to keep in the
final object.

Applying

DF <- ddply(table, (.VAR1), numcolwise(sum)), all non-numeric columns
are not retainted in Nobject.

or

DF <- ddply(table, (.VAR1), colwise(sum)), i get:
Error in Summary.factor(1L, na.rm = FALSE) : sum not meaningful for
factors

All this makes sense but how can I preserve all columns, including
those where no function will be applyied?

What do you want to happen to the columns that aren't affected? There

other columns.
